# Frozen upstream resource oracle

`upstream_oracle.json` is generated by the pinned upstream production
`parseFrontmatter` and `loadPromptTemplates` exports. Inputs and runtime version
are fixed in `upstream_oracle_corpus.json`.

Run from the pinned upstream checkout:

```sh
PI_UPSTREAM_ROOT=/path/to/pi \
/path/to/pi/node_modules/.bin/tsx /path/to/pi-go/internal/resource/testdata/generate_upstream_oracle.ts
```

The command prints JSON for review; it does not overwrite the checked-in oracle.
